proof_body:
by
  intro ι s x a b m hs hx hm
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < s.card := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr hs)
  have h1 := Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum s x a (fun i hi => (hx i hi).1)
  have h2 := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul s x b (fun i hi => (hx i hi).2)
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul] at h1 h2
  rw [hm]
  constructor
  · rw [le_div_iff₀ hn]
    linarith
  · rw [div_le_iff₀ hn]
    linarith
target_source: ∀ (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (x : ι → ℝ) (a b m : ℝ), s.Nonempty → (∀ i ∈ s, a ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ b) → m = (∑ i ∈ s, x i) / s.card → a ≤ m ∧ m ≤ b
